description: Provider audio: transcribe a bundled clip (the words are checked) and generate spoken audio (real audio bytes must come back, saved next to the run file). Provider models only. The bundled clips are real spoken audio — 'hello world', 'one two three', and a weather sentence containing 'sunny'.
name: Audio

tasks.prompt: Say hello in a friendly voice.
Read this sentence aloud: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.
Say a short weather report: today will be sunny and warm.
Count from one to five out loud.
Say thank you very much for your help.
Say good morning and welcome everyone.
Say goodbye and see you tomorrow.
